6.2.49.word: where a kṛt suffix is named, the word with a gati or kāraka before it is meant too
6.2.49.why: The engine's own quotation is a denial: by the force of अनन्तर the maxim is not resorted to here; the Śekhara adds that in 6.2.49 the bare क्तान्त is taken. 6.2.49 is the jñāpaka site, not an application.
